_about: The vision as a tree, written from Destin's own words (destin-words.md). Pillars hold capabilities; capabilities hold features. Status and evidence are filled by agents from the repos; relations (needs / shares) are proposed by agents and reviewed. Status values: done (shipped to users), building (an unmerged branch or active plan exists), planned (a roadmap entry exists, no work), vision (only in Destin's words).
mission: An app that is yours: your tools, your data, your choice of AI, built and shared with everyone. The core of a personal, open-source 'artisan web' against the own-nothing-and-be-happy economy.
